what: In the full-screen loader a sine wave (four periods) grows from the left by the progress — its height is an envelope that fades at both end thirds multiplied by progress, so the swell grows as it fills and the phase advances .1 per frame. When full, the ”Loading” text drops out and the start button floats up in .5s, and on press the top and bottom panels split apart up and down over .7s ease-in-out, the logo vanishes in 1s and the wave·button in .35s. An entry gate for music or immersive sites where enabling sound must be confirmed by the visitor

options.dur: Seconds for the wave to fill by itself, default 2.4 — if the using side sends fx:progress (detail 0~1), it fills to that value instead
options.split: Board split duration (sec), default .7 — fires fx:start when done
options.amp: Wave height (ratio of panel height), default .45
options.[data-fx-part=wave]: Wave svg (optional) — created if there is no path
options.[data-fx-part=loading]: Text that drops out when full (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=start]: Start button (required) — if set to hidden, it appears once everything is full
options.[data-fx-part=up]·[data-fx-part=down]: Top and bottom split panels (create if missing, background color)
options.fx:ready·fx:start: Event the element fires when full or when the panel has fully split

use: Loading
